resources.string: Kinetic Vault only decrypts images made by Kinetic Vault. Open the original PNG; a photograph or compressed copy usually loses the hidden data.
Choose an image to inspect its original pixels.
Kinetic Vault signature found. Open Reveal to authenticate and unlock it with your gesture and passphrase.
No Kinetic Vault data found. Open the original vault PNG to try again. The X-ray below is for exploration.
X-ray amplifies the lowest bit of each colour channel. Patterns alone do not prove that an image contains hidden data.
Could not read this image unchanged. Choose an accessible, opaque original image within the device memory limit and try again.
Picture cancelled. Open an image or take another picture.
Camera unavailable. Use Open image to continue.
